Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Mahavir Kohli, learned counsel for the 
petitioner.
2. Mr. Bhupendra Koranga, learned Brief Holder 
for the State of Uttarakhand/ respondent nos.1 to 7. 
3. This Court vide previous order dated 
09.01.2024, has sought instructions from learned 
State Counsel as to whether recovery has been made 
from the petitioner or not.
4. Today, on instructions, learned State Counsel 
has made a statement that till date, no recovery has 
been made from the petitioner.
5. From perusal of the impugned order dated 
05.06.2023, the recovery of Rs.4,85,971/- was 
directed to be made from the petitioner. Petitioner is 
a low paid and a retired employee of the respondent￾department. The order impugned in the writ petition 
has financial consequences to the petitioner.
6. Learned State Counsel prays for and is granted 
six weeks’ time for filing counter affidavit.
7. Thereafter, two weeks’ time is granted for 
filing rejoinder affidavit.
8. List on 12.06.2024.
9. In this view of the matter, the effect and 
operation of impugned letter/order dated 05.06.2023 
(Annexure No.5), issued by Executive Engineer, 
Provincial Division, PWD, Pauri, shall remain 
stayed, till next date of listing.
10. Stay application (IA/1/2023) stands disposed 
of.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 10.01.2024

COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPSS No. 2364 of 2023
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Mahavir Kohli, Advocate for the 
petitioner.
Mr. Rajeev Singh Bisht, Additional C.S.C. 
for the State/respondent nos. 1 to 7.
The petitioner claims that he was retired 
on 31.01.2022 from Group-D post, but he has 
not been paid any of his retiral dues.
Learned State counsel would submit that 
there is some dispute with regard to the 
amount that is payable.
Learned counsel for the petitioner would 
submit that in para 7 of its counter affidavit, 
the State has admitted that the gratuity is to be 
paid to the petitioner. He seeks time to file 
rejoinder affidavit seeking further direction to 
the respondents to release his gratuity.
List on 20.05.2025 for final hearing. 
Meanwhile, the respondents shall release 
the gratuity, which the respondents admits to 
be payable to the petitioner. It shall be so paid 
within four weeks from today. If it is not done, 
the Court would initiate stringent action 
against the respondent no.5 Executive 
Engineer, Provincial Division, Public Works 
Department, Pauri, District Pauri Garhwal. In 
case, the respondent no.5 fails, the Court shall 
consider it as his personal failure and an 
appropriate action shall be taken against him.
In case, the gratuity amount is not 
deposited in the account of the petitioner 
within three weeks, the petitioner shall be at 
liberty to mention the case before this Court.
Let a copy of this order be forward to the 
respondent no.5, Executive Engineer, Provincial 
Division, Public Works Department, Pauri, 
District Pauri Garhwal.
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.) 
 24.02.2025
Jitendra

Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
 Mr. Mahavir Kohli, Advocate for the 
petitioners.
 Mr. Rajeev Singh Bisht, Additional Chief 
Standing Counsel for the 
State/respondents.
 On 24.02.2025, this Court passed the 
following order:-
 “Meanwhile, the respondents shall 
release the gratuity, which the respondents 
admits to be payable to the petitioner. It 
shall be so paid within four weeks from 
today. If it is not done, the Court would 
initiate stringent action against the 
respondent no.5 Executive Engineer, 
Provincial Division, Public Works 
Department, Pauri, District Pauri Garhwal. 
In case, the respondent no.5 fails, the Court 
shall consider it as his personal failure and 
an appropriate action shall be taken against 
him.”
 Now, a Modification Application has 
been filed. 
 Learned State Counsel would submit 
that, in fact, gratuity has not been 
admitted. 
 Let State file a short affidavit giving 
response to the following:-
(i) Whether gratuity is payable to the 
petitioner? If so, what is the 
amount admitted to the State?
(ii) Why it has not been paid up till 
now?  Let a short affidavit be filed within a 
week.
 List on 18.06.2025, just after fresh 
cases. 
 
(Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 04.06.2025
Sanjay
